title: Dynamics 365 Sales: personalise outreach emails written by the Sales Qualification Agent
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, optional configuration, licensing prerequisites and controls are supported. Minor corrections should add the explicit email-consumption citation, narrow the attribution about targets, and align the governance checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: Administrators can personalize outreach emails generated by the Sales Qualification Agent.
claims.quote: As an administrator, you can personalize these emails to align with your organization's brand voice, outreach scenarios, and messaging preferences.

claims.claim: Guidance can define the outreach scenario or goal.
claims.quote: | **Outreach scenario** | The purpose or goal of the email. For example, end of trial, event follow-up, re-engagement. |

claims.claim: Guidance can specify the call-to-action.
claims.quote: | **Call-to-action** | The desired next step for the recipient. For example, book a meeting, request an introduction. |

claims.claim: Guidance can provide a fixed subject line suggestion or a style recommendation.
claims.quote: | **Subject line** | A fixed suggestion or style recommendation for subject lines. |

claims.claim: Guidance can specify tone and voice, name-usage limits and preferred terminology.
claims.quote: | **Tone and voice** | Brand-aligned tone guidance, name-usage limits, and preferred terminology. |

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Guidance can specify brand language with approved phrases and banned words.
claims.quote: | **Brand language** | Approved phrases, banned words, and voice guardrails. |

claims.claim: Guidance can specify message length and brevity targets.
claims.quote: | **Message length** | Brevity targets and word count preferences. |

claims.claim: Guidance can specify formatting preferences, including paragraph length and maximum bullet count.
claims.quote: | **Formatting** | Bullet or paragraph style, paragraph length, and maximum bullet count |

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: After rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn describes message length and formatting preferences as targets rather than rigid constraints.
claims.quote: These are preferences that guide the agent's output. The agent uses them as targets rather than rigid constraints.
claims.fix: Replace the After rollout bullet with 'Read a sample of generated emails against the banned words, length and formatting rules. Learn describes message length and formatting preferences as targets rather than rigid constraints.' In the risk rationale, replace 'so a banned word or limit is not a guaranteed block' with 'so a length or formatting preference is not a guaranteed block'. The targets statement covers message length and formatting, not banned words: https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/sales/sales-qualification-agent-email-personalization#set-message-length-and-formatting-preferences.

claims.claim: The setup article recommends testing the agent on a smaller scale before a production scenario.
claims.quote: We recommend that you test the agent's functionality on a smaller scale before testing it for your production scenario.

claims.claim: Research is selected by default and is not editable when creating the agent.
claims.quote: **Research** is selected by default and is non-editable.

claims.claim: Engage capability can optionally be added.
claims.quote: You can add engage capabilities to the agent by selecting **Engage**.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: In Research and engage mode, the agent generates and sends outreach emails to leads.
claims.quote:
| Generate outreach emails | ✅ | ✅ |
| Send outreach emails | ❌ | ✅ |

claims.claim: The setup article describes customized email instructions as an additional Engage setting.
claims.quote: The configuration steps are similar for both types, but the Engage has additional settings such as adding email signature, customized email instructions, and configuring BANT criteria for handover to work autonomously.

claims.claim: The setup prerequisites include server-side synchronization integrating Dynamics 365 with Exchange.
claims.quote: You configured server-side synchronization by integrating Dynamics 365 with Exchange.

claims.claim: Without server-side synchronization, the agent does not generate outreach emails or engage with leads.
claims.quote: If server-side synchronization isn't set up, the agent doesn't generate outreach emails or engage with leads.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; summary; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Sales Qualification Agent's AI-generated initial outreach emails consume billed capacity, supporting consumption licensing.
claims.quote: The Sales Qualification Agent uses Copilot Studio capacity for research, matching the target customer profile, and generating the initial outreach email.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/sales/sales-qualification-agent-faq to sources and cite its 'What activities consume Copilot Studio capacity?' section for the claim that generating outreach emails consumes capacity.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Selected Sales Copilot and agent capabilities charge per use and the Sales billing article calls the units Copilot Studio messages.
claims.quote: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 Sales use consumption-based billing, charging per use. These capabilities use Microsoft Copilot Studio messages for AI interactions and tasks, like retrieving information and responding to prompts.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Prepaid capacity uses Copilot Studio message pack subscriptions.
claims.quote: The prepaid capacity model uses Copilot Studio message pack subscriptions, which are a licensing option for Microsoft Copilot Studio that you purchase in advance.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go is the other supported billing model.
claims.quote: Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 Sales support two billing models: prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes

claims.quote: The Sales Qualification Agent uses the capacity assigned to your tenant to process leads and generate insights. You can set up either prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go capacity for the agent.
